scope: Capture complete actual prepared type-universe metadata with retained source identities, then compare every normalized record to the CSharp registry. No count-only equality or cache-consumption claim.

decisions: Preserve existing explicit-ID capture compatibility and always register Range once.
Validate all selected IDs and retained declaration membership before publishing any metadata. Failed private capture returns no partial table.
Canonicalized SourceText uses retained source coordinates while keeping final runtime field identities.
Normalization uses declared identity, structural dependency identity and complete metadata fields, preserving alias multiplicity. Numeric ID and cache-key equality remain separate obligations.
New CSharp named observer mode adds type names only: current records, builtin roles and actual hash were byte-value equivalent to the previous reference.
Native name failures remain explicit; a missing leaf identity needed by a metadata record cannot be silently replaced.
Complete comparison writes missing/extra records and category counts; unequal output fails instead of weakening the expected table.
